_note: T21 (phase A): the first dungeon's rooms. crates/core/src/dungeon.rs reads this file, compiled in. Each room is a space of its own, built high over the land far north of the region (`origin_m`: x east, y up, z south), so nothing in the overworld is near it and it is drawn only from inside it (the places' 3 km fade). A room is a box: its floor at the origin's height, walls round it, a ceiling. Positions inside a room are centimetres from its centre, x east, z south, as on the journal's mockups. `ledges` and `pillars` are raised floors you stand on (their tops in centimetres over the room's floor); a `ramp` climbs from one height to another along x. A door stands in a wall (`wall`: n, s, e or w) `along_cm` from the wall's middle, on a sill `top_cm` up; it leads to another room's door, out to the world, or is closed with a line. Colours are the room's own (journal: rooms.svg), 0 to 255.
_origin_m: 11 km north of the village, beyond the far ring of mountains, 1.9 km up: dungeon.rs's tests hold every room's floor at least 100 m over the land under it
_outside: the great tree in the forest (journal: map.svg, entrance.svg): its trunk's middle, its door facing south on the trunk's face (trunk_cm out), the tree tree_cm tall. Out of the dungeon the player stands out_cm in front of the door. Two sockets stand either side of the door (side_cm along the trunk's face, up_cm up); an orb from the roots' bulb, turned by the player's blade within aim_deg of a dark socket, flies straight to it, and lights it when it passes within catch_cm. Both lit, the door opens. The bulb sits at_cm from the trunk's middle (x east, y up, z south) and throws the trainer's single slow orb at the player every `every` ticks while they are within range_cm and the door is shut.

rooms._pillars: x, z, radius, top (cm): six-sided root pillars; the one at (0, 250) holds the healing spring
rooms._ledges: x0, z0, x1, z1, top (cm): the entrance's ledge (south), the left door's (west), the right door's (east), the centre door's (north)
rooms._ramps: x0, z0, x1, z1, height at x0, height at x1 (cm): the slope back up from the floor to the entrance's ledge, along the south wall

_door_reach_cm: E opens a door from this close to its middle
_door_inside_cm: through a door, the player stands this far in from it, facing into the room
_dark_ticks: a door fades the view out over these ticks, moves the player, then holds the dark and fades back in
_heal_per_tick: standing in a healing spring restores this much health a tick (60 a second) up to full
